verdict.rationale: Termius is an SSH/terminal client for managing hosts, keys, snippets and sessions. Amending or undoing git commits is a source-control capability outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Termius ships any git features, and running git inside a remote shell would be a host-side workaround rather than a product capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can amend the latest commit or undo unpushed commits to fix or split them
